refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback highlights two high/medium-priority CQ coverage gaps: (1) CQ13 (explicit validation constraints for mandatory fields/consistency) and (2) CQ5 (aggregation of all organization-related information for a single view). Quality suggestions include adding General Class Axioms (GCAs), owl:equivalentClass axioms for key concepts (e.g., BuyerRoleAssignment), and cardinality/value restrictions (e.g., InvoiceMessage must have exactly one invoice number, at least one buyer and seller). Lower priority: expand EDIFACT segment/code vocabularies, add annotations (rdfs:seeAlso, skos:notation) for standards crosswalk. No current constraint violations or OWL2 DL issues. Plan: 1) Add SHACL-like constraints as OWL axioms for required fields (CQ13) and create example ValidationConstraint individuals; 2) Model an OrganizationView class (or property chain) for CQ5; 3) Add GCAs/equivalentClass for BuyerRoleAssignment; 4) Add cardinality restrictions on InvoiceMessage (invoiceNumber, buyer/seller presence); 5) If time, add example segment codes and annotations for standards mapping.
